entries.title: Psalms 130:3
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Mark - Observe them accurately and punish them as they deserve. Stand - At thy tribunal.

entries.title: Psalms 130:4
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Forgiveness - Thou art able and ready to forgive repenting sinners. Feared - Not with a slavish, but with a childlike fear. This mercy of thine is the foundation of all religion, without which men would desperately proceed in their impious courses.

entries.title: Psalms 130:5
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: I wait - That he would pardon my sins.

entries.title: Psalms 130:6
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: They - Whether soldiers that keep the night - watches in an army, or the priests or Levites who did so in the temple.

entries.title: Psalms 130:7
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Israel - Every true Israelite. Plenteous - Abundantly sufficient for all persons who accept it upon God's terms.
